title: Business Travel Budget Guidelines (Revised)
content: Effective April 1, 2026, this document supersedes the Business Travel Budget Guidelines v1. Acme Corp will reimburse business travel expenses up to a daily total of $200 per day for domestic travel and $350 per day for international travel. The reduction reflects updated fiscal guidelines for the current financial year. Accommodation remains subject to the company travel portal requirement. Economy class is required for all flights regardless of duration. Business class upgrades are no longer reimbursable. Meal allowances are reduced to $50 per day for domestic and $75 per day for international travel. The 30-day receipt submission deadline is unchanged.
